library.kw_104:r_23a4332fb30bf95d.text:
A mysterious mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to and drawing power from a particular kind of human emotional or mental activity.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.

library.kw_104:r_b265314c2661a9a3.text:
A mysterious mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to and drawing power from a particular kind of human emotional or mental activity.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.
At present, 8 of the 12 Spheres have been confirmed to exist: the $$偽りの黒羊$$, the Quarreling Twins, the Silent Crab, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, the $$悲しみの乙女$$, the Wavering Scales, the Curious Goat, and the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$.

library.kw_104:r_394dd3fb5ba509b7.text:
A general term for the extradimensional energy that exists among parallel worlds.
The first stage of utilizing $$次元力$$ is extracting energy from another dimension, producing amounts of energy that would be impossible under ordinary physics. Even Earth's current hyperspacetime physics has reached a level where this can be controlled to some degree.

library.kw_104:r_98ed670113a532af.text:
A general term for the extradimensional energy that exists among parallel worlds.
It is also known as the Power of Origin, or $$オリジン・ロー$$.
The first stage of utilizing $$次元力$$ is extracting energy from another dimension, producing amounts of energy that would be impossible under ordinary physics. Even Earth's current hyperspacetime physics has reached a level where this can be controlled to some degree.
However, the ultimate goal of utilizing $$次元力$$ is to elucidate and control the energy that 'establishes the world', which could be rephrased as 'control over phenomena'. In other words, if one could freely control the facts that make object A into object A, it would become possible to transform object A into object B. Likewise, if one could control the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to produce water, it would become possible to produce water from entirely different elements.
The most striking example of this is $$時空震動$$, which ignores spacetime itself and alters the very existence of the world - in other words, $$時空震動$$ is caused by $$次元力$$.
This is what is called a 'miracle', a power that could be called all-powerful, but this remains purely a theoretical conclusion, and no prospect of proving it has been established. However, research into the $$スフィア$$ suggests that the extraction and control of $$次元力$$ involves the 'will' of living beings.

library.kw_104:r_8605552e970d231c.text:
A concept said to record the past and future of all phenomena.
Accessing it is said to be equivalent to leaving the material world and obtaining infinity that transcends time.

library.kw_104:r_3ee26d16dc9ec419.text:
Her full name is $$メール$$ Beater.
She is the daughter of $$シエロ・ビーター$$, the master of $$ランド$$ Travis.
She has a childish appearance, but is actually 17 years old.
She has a plucky, mischievous personality, and her hobby is keeping a diary.
She has known $$ランド$$ since he became $$シエロ$$'s apprentice, and calls herself his fiancee, addressing him as 'Darling'.
At Beater Service she handles sales, bookkeeping, and logbook entries, and also serves as the sub-pilot of the Gunleon.
She was once fused with a $$スフィア$$, and it was thought that her body's failure to grow was because time had stopped for her. However, judging by her current condition after being freed from the $$スフィア$$, it seems the $$スフィア$$'s influence was of course a factor, but the greater cause was simply her physical constitution.

library.kw_104:r_6dc0517256919025.text:
Bacterial lifeforms that had been drifting through space.
They use Getter Rays as their primary energy source.
Individuals that had been parasitizing Getter Rays collected on the lunar surface evolved when concentrated to high density within a Getter reactor core, giving birth to the three parent Invaders that became the origin of them all.

library.kw_104:r_66b0c26f80c15f92.text:
$$ヨーコ$$, having taken up a post as a teacher on Korehana Island, far from $$カミナ$$ City.
She used a false name, $$ヨマコ$$, to break free from her past self as a member of Team Dai-Gurren.
However, her peaceful days came to an end when the Anti-Spiral activated its system to annihilate humanity. Amid the chaos, when a cruel, rogue Beastman took her students hostage, her anger exploded and she drew out her beloved rifle, driving off the Beastman in an instant.
Afterward, in order to protect her students' future, she became $$ヨーコ$$ once more, rejoined Team Dai-Gurren, and fought alongside her former comrades.

library.kw_104:r_a99ffc4d49bfccbc.text:
A general term for the creatures and objects said to be the natural enemies of intelligent life.
It is said that battles against $$バアル$$ have been waged across the entire galaxy since the distant past, but the truth of the matter remains shrouded in mystery.

library.kw_104:r_846bb1b7bd17c192.text:
A general term for the creatures and objects said to be the natural enemies of intelligent life.
It is said that battles against $$バアル$$ have been waged across the entire galaxy since the distant past, and that they appear in great numbers in response to the rebirth of the universe, which occurs on a cycle of 12,000 years. Some also say that it was beings called 'gods' who fought against $$バアル$$, and that humanity was powerless.
None of this information has been substantiated, either, and the truth of the matter and their total numbers remain shrouded in mystery to this day.

library.kw_104:r_654e7e99337dae8c.text:
A place set within a different-dimensional space connecting the $$ギアス嚮団$$ headquarters with ruins around the world.
Here, Charles zi Britannia sought to return all of humanity to the $$集合無意識$$ and create a world without lies.

library.kw_104:r_74e85aa1bc237d43.text:
According to Charles zi Britannia, 'a weapon for destroying god'.
Here, Charles sought to return all of humanity to the $$集合無意識$$ and create a world without lies.

library.kw_104:r_39407b6f8414ab98.text:
Short for 'Space Terrible Monster Crowd', a being that can be called the natural enemy of humanity. Also known as Space Monsters.
They detect the waves emitted during warp (Vanishing Drive waves) and head straight toward their source, plowing forward relentlessly and destructively. This behavior is not carried out under any clear will, but is merely instinctive, innate behavior.
Their combat ability and vitality are formidable enough, but what is truly to be feared is their reproductive capacity - their total numbers reach astronomical figures.
Many different types exist, ranging from the 'Soldiers', small combat creatures about 10 meters long, to the 'Motherships', which reach dozens of kilometers in length.
They nest at the galactic core, and attack star systems from there.

library.kw_104:r_477f2589dc5189f7.text:
Her full name is $$グレイス$$ O'Connor.
She was formerly $$シェリル$$'s manager, a woman of consummate skill who always wore a composed smile and effortlessly handled everything from scheduling to babysitting $$シェリル$$.
Her body has been fitted with cybernetic 'implants' that are illegal within the Frontier fleet, granting her functions such as the ability to hack into network lines.
She attempted to use the Frontier fleet for her own ambitions, but was ultimately unsuccessful.

library.kw_104:r_279be1d3d0dfd9f4.text:
Former Chairman of the National Defense Committee of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
Father of $$アスラン・ザラ$$.
He lost his wife in the $$地球連合$$'s surprise attack on $$ユニウスセブン$$, the incident that triggered the previous war. Because of this, he came to hate Naturals intensely and advocated all-out resistance against the $$地球連合$$. He later drove out the previous $$プラント$$ Council Chairman, the moderate Siegel Clyne, and his faction, seizing the chairmanship for himself.
In the Second Battle of Jachin Due, he attempted to annihilate the Naturals with GENESIS, a massive gamma-ray laser cannon that would also devastate Earth's environment, but was shot dead by an aide who feared for $$プラント$$'s future.
Even so, those who shared his ideology remained firmly entrenched, and it was by their hand that the operation to drop $$ユニウスセブン$$ was carried out.

library.kw_104:r_fad680476dbc691b.text:
An international organization formed under the leadership of the Atlantic Federation.
It is composed largely of the nations that once administered the PLANTs, giving it strong overtones of a military alliance directed against $$プラント$$. However, since pro-$$プラント$$ nations and neutral nations also exist on Earth, it cannot be said to be an organization that unifies the whole of Earth.

library.kw_104:r_6ae4242e62efe946.text:
An agricultural colony belonging to $$プラント$$.
When the $$地球連合$$ forces declared war on $$プラント$$, it became their first attack target and was annihilated by nuclear missiles, along with more than 200,000 residents. This incident came to be known as 'Bloody Valentine' and is passed down as a tragedy.
Later, as retaliation against the Naturals, terrorists carried out an operation to drop the wreckage of $$ユニウスセブン$$ onto Earth. Thanks to $$ザフト$$'s efforts, the wreckage was successfully broken apart before impact, but the smaller fragments still fell to Earth and caused great damage.
Amid this chaos, the $$地球連合$$ and $$プラント$$ plunged once more into war.

library.kw_104:r_7208b5954e5a1ec4.text:

When the $$地球連合$$ forces declared war on $$プラント$$, it became their first attack target and was annihilated by nuclear missiles, along with more than 200,000 residents. This incident came to be known as 'Bloody Valentine'.

Amid this chaos, the $$地球連合$$ and $$プラント$$ plunged once more into war.

library.kw_104:r_5c57e5e2b67951aa.text:
A new era name that began with the Earth Federation's start of space colonization.
It is abbreviated 'U.C.', from the initials of '$$宇宙世紀$$'.
The $$一年戦争$$ broke out in U.C. 0079, and thereafter, conflicts between the Earth Federation and the colonies occurred in various forms.

library.kw_104:r_4b4a0d3fd306693a.text:
The biological father of $$桃井いぶき$$.
A researcher in special quantum mechanics, he predicted $$界震$$ disasters even before the Heterodynes ever appeared.
In 2018, he died at the hands of the first $$ヘテロダイン$$ humanity ever encountered, which appeared off the coast of Boso, but in $$いぶき$$'s mind he continued to live on as a heroic figure who had researched the Heterodynes in order to protect the world.
However, Dohmeki, a fellow scientist, speculates that he viewed the Heterodynes purely as objects of research, and that there was no sense of justice or mission behind it. Furthermore, footage from his encounter with a $$ヘテロダイン$$ revealed an expression full of intellectual curiosity on his face, and this dealt a great shock to $$いぶき$$, who had idolized her father.

library.kw_104:r_0aee85115ccb7e1a.text:
A metal used on Planet Gabar in the Robot Empire, which does not exist on Earth.
It is used as the armor material for $$トライダーＧ７$$.

library.kw_104:r_d1821cf899579a4a.text:
A giant humanoid object that exists in Central Dogma, beneath NERV Headquarters.
$$ミサト$$ explains it as 'the Second Angel, both the origin of this planet's life and the key to its ending'.
It is also said to be the trigger for Third Impact, and it is the Evangelions' role to intercept the Angels that attack NERV Headquarters, aiming for $$リリス$$.
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$ also states that with the birth of a true Evangelion and $$リリス$$'s resurrection, the time of the covenant will come.

library.kw_104:r_0ddd71c78c10284f.text:
A being that seeks to wipe out every lifeform possessing Spiral Power.
Using $$ニア$$ as a messenger, it declared that it would bring despair upon humanity and attempted to drop the moon onto the Earth, but the plan was thwarted thanks to the efforts of $$シモン$$ and his friends.
Its full nature and true intentions remain shrouded in mystery.

library.kw_104:r_fbd96ce6b79d7de3.text:
A being that seeks to wipe out every lifeform possessing Spiral Power.
Using $$ニア$$ as a messenger, it declared that it would bring despair upon humanity and attempted to drop the moon onto the Earth, but the plan was thwarted thanks to the efforts of $$シモン$$ and his friends.
Afterward, it confronted $$シモン$$ and his friends directly in the Isolated Space, but was defeated, and entrusted the future of the universe to them.
